query: WITH verification_counts AS (SELECT verification_status, count(*) AS item_count FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 469 AND 473 GROUP BY verification_status) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 469 AND 473) AS source_pages, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 469 AND 473) AS facts, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 469 AND 473) AS notes, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 469 AND 473) AS mcqs, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0469-0473:%') AS flashcards, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d WHERE (d.entity_type = 'fact' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 469 AND 473)) OR (d.entity_type = 'note' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 469 AND 473))) AS search_documents, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.content_tag_assignments WHERE source_page BETWEEN 469 AND 473) AS tag_assignments, (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(verification_status, item_count) FROM verification_counts) AS verification_status_counts LIMIT 1;
